scientific_integrity: The universal claim is proved from exact support-line and middle-set identities together with Schneider's materially inspected lemmas. The finite checker is explicitly non-probative and is used only to catch indexing errors.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to regular odd polygons. It does not classify arbitrary odd polygons or regular even polygons, and it does not assert that odd numbers are the only possible finite convexity-point counts. Historical originality retains a residual risk from unindexed notes or correspondence.
title: Regular odd polygons have exactly as many convexity points as vertices
